s: the angels are honoured slaves (of Allah)
q: Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves;

s: the idolaters are fuel of hell (along with what they worship beside Allah)
q: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come.

s: the believers is saved by We
q: Thus we save believers.

s: the righteous inherit the earth's inheritance by the righteous (as Allah's righteous slaves)
q: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth:

s: Abraham is given his proper course (of old)
q: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,

s: Abraham is brought to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples
q: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.

s: Allah is a Lord (of the heavens and the earth)
q: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.

s: Abraham has Isaac (as a bestowed son)
q: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson.

s: Abraham has Jacob (as a grandson through Isaac)
q: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson.

s: Abraham is related to Abraham's father (as his son)
q: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?

s: Abraham speaks to his father and his folk
q: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?

s: Lot is a righteous
q: Lo! he was of the righteous.

s: Moses receives the Criterion (with Aaron)
q: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,

s: Aaron receives the Criterion (with Moses)
q: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,

s: Noah is saved from the great affliction (by Allah)
q: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.

s: David receives judgment (from Allah)
q: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.

s: David receives knowledge (from Allah)
q: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge.

s: Allah owns the heavens
q: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth.

s: Solomon receives judgment (from Allah)
q: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge.

s: Solomon receives knowledge (from Allah)
q: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge.

s: Solomon commands the wind (by Allah's subduing)
q: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed.

s: Job is afflicted by adversity
q: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.

s: Dhu'n-Nun is a wrong-doer (by his own confession)
q: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.

s: Zachariah has John (as a bestowed child)
q: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him.

s: Mary is a chaste
q: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.

s: Mary has the son of Mary (as her son)
q: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.

s: the son of Mary is a token (for all peoples)
q: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples.

s: the heavens are created by Allah (with the earth)
q: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them;

s: Allah owns the earth
q: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth.

s: the earth is created by Allah (with the heavens)
q: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them;

s: the heavens are one piece (before being parted)
q: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them

s: the earth contains ravines (as roads)
q: and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way.

s: the earth contains hills (firm, to prevent quaking)
q: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them

s: the Scripture contains the Reminder (for mankind)
q: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder.

s: the Reminder is a blessed Reminder (revealed by Allah)
q: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?

s: the Criterion is a light (for those who keep from evil)
q: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,

s: the revelations are denied by the people
q: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations.
